text.p: - Waser Holding boosted 1995-96 sales by 14 percent to 76 million Swiss francs.

- Fines for automobile, bicycle and pedestrian traffic and parking violations increased markedly throughout Switzerland as of this past Sunday. Cyclists caught on the road without a bell on their bicycles, riding "no-hands" or double, will be hit with a 20 franc fine.
- Zurich airport now forbids excessively loud jets from using the airport on weekends.
